description: Compare one indicator across several countries (latest available value each). Good for ranking or benchmarking economies.

countries.description: Array of country codes or names to compare, e.g. ["US", "DE", "JP"].

indicator.description: World Bank indicator key: gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, inflation, population, unemployment, life_expectancy, exports, imports, govt_debt_pct_gdp, real_interest_rate, fdi, co2_per_capita, internet_users. Call list_indicators for the full set. Raw World Bank codes are also accepted.

name: compare_countries
title: Compare Countries
